absolute_formula: person mean baseline_glucose + person mean mean_increment, from the same original meals
common_adjustment: original pre-meal model columns; excludes baseline_glucose and pre_slope_per_min
weighting: one row per participant; equal participant weights
inference: original OLS HC3 and residual-df t; pointwise 95% confidence intervals
interpretation: Post-result exploratory extensions. Overlapping samples; original main results retained. No causal mediation or independent validation.
